clinical_rf.architecture: Random Forest (350 trees, entropy criterion, seed 42)
clinical_rf.provenance: Paper-reported reference values from Cleveland cohort test split. Must be reproduced with real held-out data.

ecg_rf.architecture: Random Forest (250 trees, sqrt features, seed 42)
ecg_rf.provenance: Paper-reported reference values on pattern annotation classification task. Not direct clinical diagnosis.

multimodal_fusion.provenance: Exploratory linear heuristic; paper lacked paired clinical-ECG test subjects, so no empirical fusion ROC-AUC or accuracy claim is validated.
